...You didn't come to our side from Lufenas\nfamily's side, Balft...
When you were young, you volunteered to the Black\nKnights to protect the Lufenas Family and the girl.
I appreciated your sincerity even though other\nknights opposed my idea.
So, I decided to accept you with my own authority.
I expected you to grow up as a true black knight\nthrough the missions and experience...
It's Lufenas Family and the girl that fill your\nmind, not the fidelity to the empire...
Forgive me that I couldn't guide you to the right\npath...
It's not your fault, sir.
However.. I just can't believe that the empire is\non the right path now!
We are proud knights of the empire!
Even if other people think we're wrong,\nwe must carve out the way that...
Her majesty believes in!!
Come on!\nRemember why you came here!
Yes... That's right. Adventurer...
Sir, if that's your faith, we can never understand\neach other.
I'll fight you to follow the path I believed\nin with this adventurer.
Now!!
Seems like your faith is stronger than me...
But I won't change what I believed in.\nAnd the weaker one has to be erased.
Now, destroy it with your hands.
How could I do this...
How could I kill the one who trained me until now\njust because we have different faiths!!
Sir, please come back.\nHer Majesty is calling you...
Her Majesty is going to deal with them...
But it's a shame of the Black Knights to trouble\nher Majesty...
Seems like I have to live a little longer...
Balft Volsax...\nNow you are dismissed from the Black Knights.
Sir?! What did you say?!\nThat's unprecedented...
Yea!\nBetrayers have to be dismissed by death!!
We part our ways with a proud knight just because\nwe have different faiths... That's it...
Follow the path you believe in...\nBut the next time we meet shall be the end of\nour battle.
It won't take long though...
Is there anything left undone?\n*[ffff64]Your choice makes no difference to the story[ffffff].

Explore here a little longer.
Your ex-superior said the time would soon\ncome...
It's really soon if we keep going.\nWhat are you gonna do?
Let's proceed...\nThe empress should be ahead of here.
I must stop her to save people!
